mapper.select: select payload from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and (id=#{parent} or payload->>'$.familyId'=#{family})
mapper.update: update history_document set payload=#{payload},parse_due_at=utc_timestamp(6),parse_token=null where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=1
mapper.select: select bu_id,id from history_document where parse_due_at<=utc_timestamp(6) order by parse_due_at,bu_id,id limit 1
mapper.update: update history_document set parse_token=#{token},parse_due_at=timestampadd(minute,5,utc_timestamp(6)) where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=1 and parse_due_at<=utc_timestamp(6)
mapper.select: select originals from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=1 and parse_token=#{token}
mapper.update: update history_document set parse_due_at=timestampadd(minute,5,utc_timestamp(6)) where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=1 and parse_token=#{token}
mapper.select: select project_id,payload from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=1 and parse_token=#{token} for update
mapper.update: update history_document set payload=#{payload},parse_due_at=null,parse_token=null where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and version=1
mapper.select: select payload from `history-rfq-record` where bu_id=#{buId} and payload->>'$.documentId'=#{id} and coalesce(payload->>'$.status','')<>'已删除' order by id,version for update
mapper.update: update history_document set payload=#{payload},fingerprint=null,parse_due_at=null,parse_token=null where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id}
update history_document set payload=#{payload} where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id}
mapper.select: select project_id,scope,payload,originals from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} order by version desc limit 1
select project_id,scope,originals from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} order by version desc limit 1
select project_id,scope from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} order by version desc limit 1
select id from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and id=#{id} and payload->>'$.status'='已删除'
select payload from history_document where bu_id=#{buId} and fingerprint=#{fingerprint} for update

select id,payload from history_document where bu_id=#{bu} and ((project_id is null and scope='BU共享') or (project_id=#{project} and scope='仅当前项目')) and case when json_type(payload->'$.groupIds')='ARRAY' then json_contains(payload->'$.groupIds',json_quote(#{groupId})) else payload->>'$.groupId'=#{groupId} end

select d.id,d.payload, exists(select 1 from `history-rfq-record` r where r.bu_id=d.bu_id and r.project_id <=> d.project_id and r.scope=d.scope and r.payload->>'$.documentId'=d.id and r.payload->>'$.status'='已发布' and r.payload->>'$.validity'='有效') as published, exists(select 1 from `history-rfq-record` r left join history_rfq_index_sync s on s.bu_id=r.bu_id and s.reply_id=r.id where d.project_id is null and r.bu_id=d.bu_id and r.project_id is null and r.scope=d.scope and r.payload->>'$.documentId'=d.id and r.payload->>'$.status'='已发布' and r.payload->>'$.validity'='有效' and (s.synced_at is null or s.operation<>'upsert' or s.version<>r.version)) as syncing from history_document d where d.bu_id=#{bu} and ((d.project_id is null and d.scope='BU共享') or (d.project_id=#{project} and d.scope='仅当前项目')) order by d.id
